Highway Noise Abatement
The most common solution for the reduction of freeway noise is the construction of noise barriers. Hoise barriers, earth berms, or a combination of the two will be constructed adjacent to the Airport Spur as shown in Figure 30. Darrier design accompanied by sufficient landscaping will be utilized to produce an aesthetically pleasing view.
The 1990 predicted noise levels utilizing these noise barriers will meet the 70dBA noise standards. Hone of the residents will be adversely affected by noise and some will actually experience as much as 12dBA reduction in the existing noise levels caused by I-94.
In addition, an air conditioning system will be provided at Hamlin Garland School. The combination of noise barriers and air conditioning will reduce the noise levels inside the school to 45dBA, well below the interior noise standards. Air conditioning of Hamlin Garland School is estimated to cost $50,000. The estimated cost of construction for noise barriers is $350,000.
